evidence: The substrate temperature was in the range of 560-600 DC. The growth process starts by heating the substrate under AsH3 (tube A 1 for a few minutes. The substrate is then exposed to the TMG (tube B 1 for 1 s and then moved back under the AsH3 for 5 s. One complete cycle was performed in about 10 s. All growths consisted of 100 cycles.
